subject: Allow hit retaliation to enter swordfight from non-attacking AI states
description: DONE. After #42, nicouzouf S069 r005 frame465 showed Soldier197 receiving synchronous EVENT_GOTHIT outside STATE_ATTACKING. Original's generic hit arm calls AttackEnemy/ReconsiderEnemyApproach and BeginSwordfight when close; BeginSwordfight has no state admission gate. Rust invented current_state == Attacking and discarded this path, omitting EnterSwordfight, reciprocal opponents, and the LOS query. Removing the gate restores the source behavior. A focused Default-state close retaliation regression passes. Exact replay clears frame465 and advances to unrelated #47 SwordStrikeSelection RNG at frame1299.
